verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents Runbooks as its automation engine. A default Runbook attaches to every incident, and other Runbooks evaluate their conditions automatically whenever an incident is declared. Documented steps include assigning roles, adding task lists, automating Slack channel and ticket creation, and sending webhooks to internal systems (e.g., rollbacks), which can serve for diagnostics. Missing for 10: a native diagnostics step (diagnostics only via generic webhook), explicit docs tying channel creation to a specific runbook step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
